note: In Mathlib v4.16.0, `ZMod.chevalley_warning` (Mathlib.NumberTheory.LegendreSymbol.QuadraticReciprocity / Polynomial.ChevalleyWarning) proves zero-sum mod p directly once you lift Fin (2p-1) -> ZMod p via two polynomials of degree p-1 and 1. Avoid finite case-splits; use `Finset.sum_pow_card_sub_one_eq_zero`.
